about_the_game:
This DLC includes combat supplies, weapons, a safe container, hideout upgrades, and EZD. It enhances your battlefield survivability and strengthens your combat power, ensuring you are fully prepared to face the challenges ahead.

Pack Includes:

  • Safe container：

    • Mars container (6 slots space)

  • Hide Out:

    • Unlock Area: Workshop

    • Unlock facility: TV Set

    • Unlock facility: Water Collector

    • HQ Power Fuel Can L ( 1pcs.)

  • Storage box:

    • Medical Box (1 pcs.)

  • High value Items:

    • Gold ingot (2 pcs.)

  • Weapons:

    • UMP45 .45ACP SMG (1 pcs.)

    • M1911 .45ACP pistol (2 pcs.)

    • RC416 5.56x45 assault rifle (1 pcs.)

    • AK74N Mod.MMC 5.45x39 assault rifle (1 pcs.)

    • AR STANAG Mag 5.56x45 30-round (3 pcs.)

    • P-Mag 5.45x39 30-round (3 pcs.)

    • M1911 .45ACP Mag 11-round (6 pcs.)

    • UMP45 .45ACP Mag 25-round (3 pcs.)

    • RGD-5 Hand grenade (2 pcs.)

    • Cobra (optic attachments) ( 2 pcs.)

  • Gears:

    • SoftArmor (lv.3 Armor) (2 pcs.)

    • JPC (lv.4 Armor) (2 pcs.)

    • PASGT helmet (lv.3 Helmet) (2 pcs.)

    • 3DRT Backpack (2 pcs.)

    • G.N.J.Backpack (1 pcs.)

    • Mag pouch M (4 pcs.)

    • Grenade pouch (1 pcs.)

    • Mag Double Pouch (1 pcs.)

    • Mag pouch S (4 pcs.)

  • Ammo：

    • 5.56x45mm MK318 (15 Rounds) (10 pcs.)

    • .45acp L-Match (15 Rounds) (10 pcs.)

    • 5.45x39mm PP (15 Rounds) (10 pcs.)

  • Medical Items：

    • M.I.C.A. Device (2 pcs.)

    • Apex Suturing Instrument (2 pcs.)

    • Military Bandage (4 pcs.)

    • H.C. stimulant injector (2 pcs.)

    • Military Syringe (2 pcs.)

    • Advanced Syringe (2 pcs.)

    • Painkiller L2 (2 pcs.)

    • Morphine Injector (2 pcs.)

  • Provision:

    • Pea Can (4 pcs.)

    • Meat Can (2 pcs.)

    • Mineral Water (4 pcs.)

    • Water Bottle (4 pcs.)

The safe container unlocks immediately upon acquisition. Use the safe container panel in the hideout to manage your containers.

Unlocking Facilities will not affect the already-unlocked status and will not cause downgrades.

Items included in this DLC will be sent via multiple in-game mails. Please check your mailbox after purchase to claim your items.

DLC contents will be reissued after each data reset, its actual content is subject to change in future updates.
